title: Finite-dimensional black-hole information and Page-curve laboratory
claim_ceiling: Finite-dimensional quantum-information model validation only. This manifest does not derive the island formula, model a four-dimensional evaporating black hole, or solve the black-hole information paradox.

subsystems.name: remaining black-hole register
subsystems.meaning: The degrees of freedom still acted on by the declared evaporation circuit.

subsystems.name: collected radiation
subsystems.meaning: The emitted register factors that are no longer acted on by later circuit layers.

subsystems.name: reference
subsystems.meaning: Optional external system purifying or entangled with the initial black-hole state.

subsystems.name: bath or environment
subsystems.meaning: Optional explicit environment; never silently traced out.

required_distinctions: global unitary evolution versus reduced-state mixedness
partial trace versus fundamental non-unitary evolution
existence of a recovery map versus an efficient operational decoder
Page-curve reproduction versus microscopic gravitational explanation
HDC concept encoding versus density matrix or quantum entropy

implementation_contract.numeric_representation: complex f64 initially; high-precision references are independent fixtures
implementation_contract.entropy_units: nats unless a case explicitly declares bits
forbidden_behaviors: diagonal-only von Neumann entropy for non-diagonal density matrices
silent density-matrix projection onto the PSD cone
post-hoc state renormalization that hides accumulated drift
treating one random circuit draw as a Haar-ensemble expectation
treating circuit outputs as a gravitational path-integral calculation
implementation_contract.charge_symmetry: U(1) excitation-number conservation for equal-gap qubits; each local gate is block diagonal on pair excitation sectors 0, 1, 2
implementation_contract.emission_semantics: After the boundary-pair unitary, one active tensor factor is appended to radiation and excluded from all later gates
implementation_contract.complementarity: For the closed globally pure register, calculate S(R) and S(B) independently at every nontrivial cut and report their absolute difference
implementation_contract.energy_ledger: For equal-gap qubits with H = hbar*omega*N, record N_R and N_B separately and verify N = N_R + N_B at every emission step; report per-emission occupation expectation.
implementation_contract.symmetry_resolved_page_reference: For a U(1)-conserving fixed-total-excitation model compare only with the exact Haar average inside that same charge sector; the unconstrained Page formula is an invalid equilibrium comparator unless symmetry breaking is explicitly part of the model.
implementation_contract.symmetry_sector_reference: A fixed-charge pure-state ensemble has a symmetry-resolved Page average; do not substitute the unconstrained Haar Page formula.
implementation_contract.domain_wall_transport: Measure site occupations and oriented bond currents at every nearest-neighbour brickwork layer. Enforce delta n_i = j_(i-1->i) - j_(i->i+1) and independently verify that integrated central-cut current equals the loss of charge from the left half. Entropy growth alone is not a transport diagnostic.
implementation_contract.recoverability: Separate reference-black-hole decoupling, information availability in accessible radiation, existence of a recovery map, and an efficient operational decoder. A small I(Q:B') is only a decoupling diagnostic; it does not by itself demonstrate a decoder or its cost.
implementation_contract.decoder_evidence: Any operational recovery claim requires the decoder's access set, channel convention, fidelity/error metric, success probability and resource cost. Decoupling is a necessary diagnostic in relevant models, not an implemented decoder.
implementation_contract.operator_spreading: Track operator evolution separately from state entanglement and conserved-charge transport. Use normalized Hilbert-Schmidt squared commutators with explicit operator and probe conventions; preserve norm and report finite-size/seed uncertainty.

acceptance.oracle: independent small-matrix eigensolver or analytic spectrum
acceptance.failure_policy: typed rejection; do not silently repair invalid states

benchmark_ladder.name: Haar random-state Page benchmark

reference.source: Page 1993; exact Haar average, not an evaporation Hamiltonian

benchmark_ladder.implementation_status: Page reference formula and seeded ChaCha20 Haar-state ensemble sampler authored with Welford uncertainty; not executed in Rust

benchmark_ladder.name: symmetry-resolved Haar/Page equilibrium for fixed U(1) charge
benchmark_ladder.model: Haar-random pure state inside a fixed total-excitation sector K of N qubits

reference.formula: E[S_A] = H_D - sum_q (d_q/D) H_(d_q) + sum_q (d_q/D) Page(m_q,n_q)

definitions.Page: exact complex-Haar Page average for dimensions m_q and n_q

reference.interpretation: The charge blocks have Dirichlet-distributed weights with parameters d_q; each normalized block is an independent Haar bipartite state. This is the exact average for the stated finite-dimensional symmetry sector.

acceptance.ensemble_mean: inside preregistered sampling confidence interval or within a declared standard-error threshold

benchmark_ladder.implementation_status: exact symmetry-resolved Page oracle and seeded fixed-charge Haar sampler with Welford statistics authored; Rust execution pending
benchmark_ladder.claim_ceiling: Finite-dimensional Haar random states within an exact U(1) charge sector. No claim about gravitational evaporation, a local circuit reaching equilibrium, a Page island, or QES dominance.

benchmark_ladder.name: sequential unitary evaporation toy model
benchmark_ladder.model: apply a declared scrambler only to remaining B, then move one output factor into R and never act on it again

acceptance.u1_circuit_mixing_claim_requires: depth sweep, independent seed ensembles, uncertainty intervals, and convergence/stationarity test
acceptance.transport_diffusion_exponent: only claim exponent after multi-size, multi-seed, intermediate-time finite-size scaling; target 0.5 +/- 0.1 for diffusive domain-wall imbalance

benchmark_ladder.implementation_status: closed-register scramblers, symmetry-resolved Haar/Page oracle and sampler, U(1)-conserving finite-depth product-state circuits, product-state sequential factor transfer, and domain-wall transport source plus ensemble statistics authored; Rust runner validation pending
benchmark_ladder.claim_ceiling: Finite-dimensional closed qubit-chain unitary circuits and tensor-factor transfer with exact excitation conservation and a symmetry-sector Haar reference. The sequential model starts from a low-entanglement product state. None of these are Hawking radiation, gravitational backreaction, a Page-island/QES calculation, or a four-dimensional black-hole evaporation derivation.

equilibrium_reference.model: Haar-random pure state restricted to the exact total-excitation sector
equilibrium_reference.caveat: The oracle is a kinematic equilibrium reference. The chosen local or boundary-emission circuit must independently demonstrate mixing toward it; no convergence is presumed.

initial_condition.preparation: for 0<K<N, occupy qubit 0, leave qubit 1 empty, and choose K-1 occupied sites from {2,...,N-1} using the declared seeded PRNG; vacuum and fully-filled sectors are explicit trivial controls
initial_condition.rationale: A Haar-random fixed-sector initial state is already at the symmetry-sector equilibrium ensemble, so it is not a valid low-entanglement initial condition for studying scrambling growth or an evaporation-like entropy history.

benchmark_ladder.name: U(1) domain-wall transport and charge diffusion
benchmark_ladder.model: even-length half-filled 1D spin-1/2 chain, initial |111...1000...0> product state, nearest-neighbour brickwork gates sampled independently from U(1) x U(2) x U(1)

acceptance.diffusive_scaling_claim_requires: N sweep, independent seed ensembles, predeclared intermediate-time window, finite-size control and uncertainty intervals

benchmark_ladder.claim_ceiling: A finite closed U(1)-conserving qubit-chain transport/scrambling benchmark. Not a black-hole evaporation model, a gravitational Page curve, a QES/island calculation or a recovery decoder.

benchmark_ladder.name: U(1)-conserving operator spreading and squared commutators
benchmark_ladder.model: Local X operator evolved by O <- U O U^dagger under seeded nearest-neighbour U(1) brickwork gates; measure normalized squared commutators against local X and Z probes.

acceptance.claim_ceiling: Operator influence for the declared finite-depth circuit; not a recovery decoder, Page curve, or proof of thermalization.

implementation.status: single-seed and independent-seed operator-spreading APIs authored; Rust execution pending

benchmark_ladder.claim_ceiling: Finite-dimensional operator spreading under U(1)-conserving random circuits. No decoder or gravitational black-hole claim.

acceptance.negative_mutual_information: typed rejection if below declared tolerance

benchmark_ladder.name: Hayden-Preskill decoupling and reference recovery
benchmark_ladder.model: Reference Q is initially maximally entangled with injected message M; black-hole register B is initially entangled with explicit early radiation R; a declared scrambler acts on M tensor B; emitted factors E are made accessible while remaining B' is inaccessible to the decoder.

acceptance.decoder_access_set: R tensor emitted E only; never B' or its simulator memory
acceptance.exact_baseline: For small fixtures, compare with exact optimal recovery or a certified upper/lower bound
acceptance.small_fixture_target: Variational decoder entanglement fidelity within 1e-3 absolute of the exact optimum on preregistered small cases
acceptance.finite_size: Sweep message size, black-hole size, radiation fraction, seeds and conserved-charge sectors
acceptance.symmetry: For U(1) channels, decoder must declare whether it preserves charge and report sector leakage
acceptance.generalization: Train on separate scrambler seeds from held-out evaluation seeds; no decoder may receive hidden random seed/state amplitudes as side information
acceptance.noise: Report fidelity versus a declared local gate/noise model
null_controls: decoder given full global state or hidden simulator amplitudes
unrestricted recovery compared as if it preserved U(1)
recovery claim made using mutual information only
acceptance.direct_decoupling_measurement: Compute 1/2||rho_QBprime - rho_Q tensor rho_Bprime||_1 from the signed Hermitian spectrum of the difference; do not infer trace distance from mutual information.
acceptance.quantum_pinsker: D_trace <= sqrt(I(Q:Bprime)/2) with mutual information in nats; violations beyond declared tolerance fail
acceptance.pinsker_reference: For natural-log mutual information in nats, require D_trace <= sqrt(I(Q:Bprime)/2), with declared numerical tolerance.
acceptance.fixture: hayden_preskill_decoupling_u4_v1.json records the Q,M,B,R register convention, accessible set A=E tensor R, direct trace-distance formula, and independent 32-seed NumPy comparator.

benchmark_ladder.implementation_status: QI-4A source-authored one-step four-qubit decoupling experiment measures I(Q:B'), I(Q:A), direct trace distance D_tr(rho_QB', rho_Q tensor rho_B'), Pinsker consistency and pure-state information complementarity; no recovery map or decoder implemented

infer charge transport from entanglement entropy alone
omit the central-cut charge ledger while reporting integrated current
compare 1D domain-wall transport against all-to-all gates as though both had the same spatial metric

report mutual-information complementarity as entanglement recovery fidelity
allow recovery decoder to inspect the remaining black-hole register

evaluate a decoder on the same scrambler seeds used for training without held-out evaluation

infer message recovery from a large squared commutator or OTOC alone
compare normalized squared commutators with different operator conventions without conversion

call QI-4A mutual-information decoupling a successful recovery decoder
